mistakes.text: That pipe was fixed from an electrician, and you can tell.
mistakes.normalized: that pipe was fixed from an electrician and you can tell
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pôvodcu deja v Passive uvádza „by“: „by an electrician“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Původce děje v Passive uvádí „by“: „by an electrician“.
mistakes.feedback_en: In the Passive the person who does the action follows “by”: “by an electrician”.

mistakes.text: The pipe was fixed from an electrician, and you can tell.

mistakes.feedback_sk: Pôvodcu deja v Passive uvádza „by“: „by an electrician“.

mistakes.feedback_en: In the Passive the person who does the action follows “by”: “by an electrician”.

mistakes.text: That pipe was fixed by electrician, and you can tell.
mistakes.normalized: that pipe was fixed by electrician and you can tell
mistakes.feedback_en: A singular countable noun needs an article: “an electrician”.

mistakes.text: The pipe was fixed by electrician, and you can tell.

mistakes.text: That pipe fixed an electrician, and you can tell.
mistakes.normalized: that pipe fixed an electrician and you can tell
mistakes.feedback_sk: Takto by rúra opravila elektrikára; opravovali rúru, preto Passive „was fixed by“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Takhle by trubka opravila elektrikáře; opravovali trubku, proto Passive „was fixed by“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This says the pipe fixed the electrician; use the Passive “was fixed by”.

mistakes.text: The pipe fixed an electrician, and you can tell.
mistakes.normalized: the pipe fixed an electrician and you can tell
mistakes.feedback_sk: Takto by rúra opravila elektrikára; opravovali rúru, preto Passive „was fixed by“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Takhle by trubka opravila elektrikáře; opravovali trubku, proto Passive „was fixed by“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This says the pipe fixed the electrician; use the Passive “was fixed by”.

mistakes.text: An electrician fixed that pipe, and you can tell.
mistakes.normalized: an electrician fixed that pipe and you can tell
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dôraz je na rúre, nie na tom, kto ju opravil, preto sa hodí Passive: „was fixed by“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Důraz je na trubce, ne na tom, kdo ji opravil, proto se hodí Passive: „was fixed by“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The focus is on the pipe, not on who fixed it, so the Passive fits: “was fixed by”.

mistakes.text: An electrician fixed the pipe, and you can tell.
mistakes.normalized: an electrician fixed the pipe and you can tell
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dôraz je na rúre, nie na tom, kto ju opravil, preto sa hodí Passive: „was fixed by“.

mistakes.feedback_en: The focus is on the pipe, not on who fixed it, so the Passive fits: “was fixed by”.

mistakes.text: That pipe was fixed by an electrician, and it is seen on it.
mistakes.normalized: that pipe was fixed by an electrician and it is seen on it
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Je to na nej vidieť“ je „you can tell“ alebo „it shows“, nie „it is seen on it“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Je to na ní vidět“ je „you can tell“ nebo „it shows“, ne „it is seen on it“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Say “you can tell” or “it shows”, not “it is seen on it”.
